MORE THAN JUST A TIER

The recognition experience

Your support shapes how you are seen: from your name and logo to colors, styling and more. It is a simple way to stand out while helping AFWE grow.

Points & community influence

Everyone receives monthly points. Sustainers get 3x the allocation, giving you more influence on the roadmap and support priorities.

Transparent & fair

The rules are public, the process is open, and you can opt out of the recognition experience at any time. AFWE always runs, with or without it.

THE BIGGER PICTURE

A sustainable future, together.

Your contribution helps keep AFWE free, open, and evolving with more features, better support, and a stronger community.
